observation.reason: The create schema accepts repo, PR number, and comment body but exposes no caller-supplied record key or idempotency token that directly names/enforces uniqueness of the created comment. The numeric comment_id is server-issued only after creation. Embedding a token in body text would be content-level convention, not a caller-controlled prewrite server-record identity or uniqueness guarantee.
